verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is CLI v2 auto-prompt, which interactively suggests commands, parameters, resources and documentation while you compose a runnable 'aws' command (aws-docs-4), plus tab completion (aws-docs-3). That gives a glancing, terminal-based way to explore the API and run calls. A static Cost Explorer API reference exists (aws-docs-16), but probes found no published OpenAPI spec (aws-probe-3). Missing for 10: a browser-based interactive API reference, try-it/runnable examples in the docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
